model: Primo GEN24 Plus / Symo GEN24 Plus US (SunSpec int+SF with 700-series models)
applies_to: Fronius Primo/Symo GEN24 (Plus) US variants with a battery configured, SunSpec Model Type int+SF; the US map appends IEEE 1547 models 701-713 after storage model 124.
summary: The US GEN24 map carries the same SunSpec models as the rest-of-world map (common, inverter 101/103, nameplate, settings, status, controls, MPPT 160, storage 124) and then the IEEE 1547-2018 information models 701-713. This map covers the 16-bit values and controls of models 1-124 plus the AC measurement (701), capacity ratings (702), enter-service (703), AC controls (704) and storage capacity (713) blocks; the voltage/frequency trip and curve models 705-712 are left out.

addressing.note: Fronius numbers SunSpec registers from 40001 and says to send the register number minus one: register 40001 is read at address 40000 (0x9C40). The manual's RTU example reads register 40005 (Mn) with address bytes 9C 44 (40004).

firmware: Register map archive 1.2.7-2 (bundled with GEN24 firmware 1.36.x); manual 42,0410,2649 rev. 034-28092026.

source.title: Fronius GEN24 Modbus TCP & RTU (operating instructions) + Gen24_Primo_Symo_Inverter_Register_Map_Int&SF_storage_US.xlsx
source.pages: PDF English part: register addresses and examples pp. 68-70, unavailable values p. 71, scale factors pp. 74-75, Modbus settings pp. 76-79, models pp. 80-112. Register table = XLSX sheet 'Complete Map' in https://www.fronius.com/en/~/downloads/Solar%20Energy/Operating%20Instructions/gen24-modbus-api-external-docs.zip

notes: Register table from Fronius' official XLSX 'Gen24_Primo_Symo_Inverter_Register_Map_Int&SF_storage_US.xlsx' in gen24-modbus-api-external-docs.zip; changelog 1.2.4-0 says the US files add the 7xx series. Behaviour and settings from the PDF.
Models 1-124 sit at the same addresses as in the rest-of-world storage map; the 7xx models start at 40370 and the end block is at 41890.

Word order: neither the PDF nor the XLSX states the order of 32/64-bit values, so every 32/64-bit point is left out (SID, WH, event fields, ActWh, StActCtl, Tms, MPPT DCWH/Tms, and the 32-bit points of models 701-713 such as frequency, energy counters and timers).
Left out: inverter-model DCA/DCV (40097-40100), every point the XLSX marks not supported, and the trip/curve models 705-712 (volt-var, volt-watt, LV/HV/LF/HF trip, frequency droop, watt-var).
Many scale factors are auto-scaled: read each value and its SF in the same request. Unsupported values read int16 0x8000, uint16/enum16 0xFFFF.
Ranges marked 'may vary based on inverter configuration or country setup' (voltage ratings, power factor limits, enter-service thresholds) are installation dependent.

integration.summary: Enable the Modbus TCP server in the inverter web UI with int+SF and Allow Control, then poll unit ID 1. Live data is in models 103 (40070-40109) and 701; power limits can be written either through model 123 or the IEEE 1547 controls in model 704.

minimum_registers.why: Inverter model ID (101/103) - confirms int+SF layout

integration.enable: Inverter web interface > Communication > Modbus: choose TCP Server and/or RTU Server, set SunSpec Model Type int+SF, and activate 'Allow Control' for power, power factor, reactive power and battery commands.
integration.watchdog: Model 123 controls have *_RvrtTms fallback timers (0-28800 s) that restart with every Modbus message; model 124 has InOutWRte_RvrtTms. Model 704 holds reversion setpoints (the *Rvrt registers) that apply when its reversion timer expires; those timers are 32-bit and not included here.
quirks: Off-by-one: SunSpec registers are numbered from 40001; request number minus one.
Switching float/int+SF changes the address of every model after the inverter model.
Battery power appears as MPPT inputs 3 (charge) and 4 (discharge).
setup: TCP: inverter unit ID is always 1; port 502 or 1502 selectable in the web UI.
RTU: set Inverter address (1-247, factory 1), baud and parity in the web UI.
gotchas: Query sequentially (at most 2 requests in parallel) with a response timeout of at least 1 s.
After changing a value of an active mode, re-write the matching enable register with 1.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
